messages.text: Are there any bundles in stock, worth getting?
Searched the catalog · bundle deal miner combo pack

Honestly, no, not right now.

Every bundle on that page pairs something with the Hammer DC06, and the DC06 is oversold and past its window, so I can't stand behind a date for it. The one I'd otherwise point you at, NerdOctaxe plus a free NerdQX at $499, is only showing stock on the UK plug, not US.

Your better move is the Magic Miner 40T you're already set up for with Abel. 40 TH/s beats any of these bundles on hashrate and per-TH cost.
Can you get me the inoice or is it alreadt in my cart?

That invoice comes from Abel as a draft order, not from your cart, so there's nothing sitting in the cart for you to check out.

I've pinged the team to get it raised for the Magic Miner 40T plus the fan, against your RMA.
Handed to the team · Draft order / invoice with an agreed credit and discount is not mine to raise.
They're on now, so hang in this chat and Abel or Georges will pick it up here. If you step away, it comes to (email hidden)
